title: Resolve 4 SonarCloud BLOCKER taint-analysis findings blocking Release Gate
goal: PR #302 cleared Dependabot alerts and the quality-gate rating, but the SonarCloud Gate job additionally requires ZERO unresolved BUG/VULNERABILITY/CODE_SMELL issues. 4 open BLOCKER VULNERABILITY findings remain: gosecurity:S3649 SQL-injection taint on uint64 primary-key GORM First() in dept_service.go (x2) and i18n_service.go (x1), and gosecurity:S2083 path-traversal taint in dynamic_module_registry.go where the traversal guard lives behind a (string, bool) helper tuple the analyzer cannot track. Rework the three sites so the guards are analyzer-trackable, with identical runtime behavior.

out: SonarCloud quality-gate or scanner configuration changes
behavior or validation-logic changes at the three sites

taskDoc: Follow-up to #302: Release Gate SonarCloud Gate job fails with '17 unresolved SonarCloud issue(s)'; the 4 VULNERABILITY BLOCKERs are taint-analysis false positives with real guards; restructure for analyzer visibility.
